name: Creatio CRM
description: Creatio CRM is Creatio's AI-native customer relationship management experience for marketing, sales, and service on the shared Creatio no-code workflow platform. It combines customer records, sales automation, campaigns, service cases, activities, orders, documents, and adaptable CRM workflows in one Creatio tenant.
agentUseSummary: Do not create a separate Creatio CRM connection or install. Connect the canonical Creatio provider once for supported bounded OData 4 record reads and approved management under its existing Safe or Dangerous policy.

blocked.label: Create a separate Creatio CRM connection
blocked.description: Creatio CRM uses the same Creatio tenant, user identity, permissions, data model, authentication service, and OData authority as the canonical Creatio provider.

blocked.label: Install duplicate Creatio CRM tools
blocked.description: Relay mounts supported record reads and mutations once through the canonical Creatio provider rather than publishing parallel CRM tools and policy state.

blocked.label: Broaden the canonical Creatio surface
blocked.description: This alias does not add arbitrary objects, raw OData, AI agents, marketing communications, service channels, workflows, processes, custom services, administration, or other unselected Creatio operations.

blocked.label: Run separate Creatio CRM actions
blocked.description: Supported execution belongs to the canonical Creatio connection, its selected OData 4 entities, and its existing Safe or Dangerously skip permissions profile.

approvalProfiles.label: Use Creatio
approvalProfiles.description: No separate Creatio CRM actions are enabled because CRM is a product experience on the same Creatio platform, tenant, data model, and authorization boundary.

runtimeSupport.description: No duplicate Creatio CRM tools are mounted. OpenClaw uses the canonical Creatio provider for supported bounded OData 4 actions.
No duplicate Creatio CRM tools are mounted. Hermes uses the canonical Creatio provider for supported bounded OData 4 actions.

providerSetup.blocker: Creatio CRM is the marketing, sales, and service CRM experience of the same Creatio platform, not an independent provider identity or authorization surface. Publishing it separately would duplicate tenant, credential, installation, policy, audit, and runtime state already owned by the canonical Creatio provider.
providerSetup.nextAction: Keep this product-experience slug non-installable and direct discovery, setup, connection, installation, and supported execution to the canonical Creatio provider. Complete that provider's existing dedicated-user and live OData acceptance plan; revisit only if Creatio publishes a separately authorized CRM service with a distinct account and runtime contract.

evidence.supports: Creatio presents Creatio CRM as its AI CRM and workflow platform for marketing, sales, and service, with one shared no-code and automation experience rather than a separate provider identity.
Creatio's official product navigation presents CRM products for sales, marketing, and service together with workflow and no-code capabilities on one Creatio platform.
Creatio documents shared platform integration services, including OData 4 for data CRUD, rather than a second Creatio CRM authentication or API authority.
Creatio documents one tenant-local OData 4 resource model for the business objects used by its platform and CRM experiences.
